leadText:
Metagross Mountain is an -exclusive location in the Sinnoh region. It appeared in Noodles! Roamin' Off!. 

Metagross Mountain is a mountain well-known for having a dangerous . Indeed, multiple people have vanished on Metagross Mountain trying to catch its namesake Metagross, despite a sign placed near the base of the mountain warning people of its dangers.

The mountain's foothills is home to a town whose biggest attraction is the flagship location of a chain of ramen shops.

James foolishly hiked up the mountain, upset after Jessie and left to pursue their dreams. He challenged the Shiny Metagross to a battle, though was quickly overwhelmed. Jessie and Meowth later intervened, however the trio were soon blasted off by the Metagross.
